WITH rev AS (
  SELECT p.category,
         SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rev_q2,
         SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rev_q3
  FROM purchases pu
  JOIN products p ON pu.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT category
FROM rev
WHERE rev_q2 > 0
ORDER BY ((rev_q2 - rev_q3)/rev_q2)*100 DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH first_purchases AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(purchase_date) AS first_date
  FROM purchases
  GROUP BY user_id
),
second_purchases AS (
  SELECT p.user_id
  FROM purchases p
  JOIN first_purchases fp ON p.user_id = fp.user_id
  WHERE date(p.purchase_date) > date(fp.first_date)
    AND date(p.purchase_date) <= date(fp.first_date, '+30 days')
  GROUP BY p.user_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM second_purchases;

SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN (SELECT total_amount FROM purchases ORDER BY total_amount LIMIT 1 OFFSET CAST(cnt/2 AS INTEGER)) ELSE ((SELECT total_amount FROM purchases ORDER BY total_amount LIMIT 1 OFFSET CAST(cnt/2 AS INTEGER)-1) + (SELECT total_amount FROM purchases ORDER BY total_amount LIMIT 1 OFFSET CAST(cnt/2 AS INTEGER))) / 2.0 END, 2) AS median_total_amount FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM purchases);

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT total_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM purchases
)
SELECT ROUND(
  CASE WHEN cnt % 2 = 1
    THEN total_amount
    ELSE (total_amount + (SELECT total_amount FROM ordered o2 WHERE o2.rn = ordered.rn + 1)) / 2.0
  END, 2) AS median_total_amount
FROM ordered
WHERE rn = CASE WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN (cnt + 1)/2 ELSE cnt/2 END;

SELECT category, pct_drop FROM (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', pr.purchase_date) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN pr.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rev_q2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', pr.purchase_date) BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN pr.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rev_q3,
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', pr.purchase_date) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN pr.total_amount ELSE 0 END) -
      SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', pr.purchase_date) BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN pr.total_amount ELSE 0 END))
     / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', pr.purchase_date) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN pr.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
     ) * 100 AS pct_drop
  FROM purchases pr
  JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y', pr.purchase_date) = '2024'
  GROUP BY p.category
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', pr.purchase_date) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN pr.total_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
) ORDER BY pct_drop DESC LIMIT 1;
